searchText: Hi mates, Trying to understand why do I need to upload the "deposit_data" file generated by the "staking-deposit-cli", according to the code the "deposit_data" file contains my secret creds for the staked ETHs. it does not contain any secret stuff It contains your public key, your withdrawal credentials (or address), i.e. all information that needs to be processed publicly by the deposit contract and the beacon chain.

excerpts.content:
Hi mates,
Trying to understand  why do I need to upload the "deposit_data" file generated by the "staking-deposit-cli", according to the code the "deposit_data" file contains my secret creds  for the staked ETHs.

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content: it does not contain any secret stuff

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content: It contains your public key, your withdrawal credentials (or address), i.e. all information that needs to be processed publicly by the deposit contract and the beacon chain.
